types.access: See a copy of the data

meta.title: Your privacy requests
meta.description: Ask to see, correct or erase the data Friends of Animals keeps about you or your child, and follow your requests.

list.title: Your privacy requests
list.lead: You can ask for a copy of the data Friends of Animals keeps about you or a child you look after, ask us to correct it, or ask us to erase it. FOA's grievance officer answers each request by its due date.
list.empty: You haven't made a privacy request yet.
list.caption: Your privacy requests, newest first

meta.title: Make a privacy request
meta.description: Ask to see, correct or erase the data Friends of Animals keeps.

new.title: Make a privacy request
new.lead: Tell us what you want and whose data it is about. We answer by email and on your requests page.

typeHints.access: See a copy: we prepare a file of everything we keep, for you to download.
typeHints.correction: Correct: tell us what is wrong and what it should say.
typeHints.erasure: Erase: we delete what we can. The law makes us keep some records for a while, such as payments and proof of consent, and we tell you which.

new.subject: Whose data is it about?
new.teenErasure: If you are under 18, your parent or guardian asks for erasure for you.
new.correctionDetails: What should we correct? (for a correction only)
new.correctionHint: Up to 2,000 characters. Say what is wrong and what it should say.

errors.invalid_input: Choose what you want and whose data it is about. A correction also needs a description of what to correct.
errors.already_open: A request like this about the same person is still open. You can follow it on your requests page.
errors.child_is_adult: Your child is 18 or older now, so they make their own requests.
errors.guardian_not_verified: Verify yourself as a guardian before making a request for a child.
errors.erasure_needs_guardian: Ask your parent or guardian to request erasure for you.
errors.under_13_needs_guardian: Ask your parent or guardian to make this request for you.
errors.forbidden: You can only make a request about yourself or a child you look after.

meta.title: Privacy request
meta.description: Follow one of your privacy requests.

view.title: Request {reference}
view.correction: What you asked us to correct
view.rejection: Why we couldn't carry it out
view.rejectionNext: If you disagree, you can write to us through the contact page, or complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

retained.title: What we kept, and why
retained.lead: We erased everything else. These records stay only as long as the reason applies.
retained.noEnd: for as long as the reason applies

categories.community_history: Community membership and private engagement history
categories.directory_publication: Public disclosure of your directory listings
categories.donation_records: Your donation, receipt and recurring mandate records
categories.consent_records: The record of consents given and withdrawn
categories.audit_log: The audit log of actions on the site

bases.audit_log: the site's audit log, which can't be changed
bases.separate_subject: each child's data is theirs: ask separately

export.title: Your copy of the data
export.preparing: We're preparing your copy. We'll email you when it's ready.
export.ready: Your copy is ready. The download link works until {date}.
export.expired: The download has expired, and the copy has been deleted. Make a new request if you need another.

cancel.title: Cancel this request
cancel.body: You can cancel it until our grievance officer starts work on it.

results.filed: Your request is in. We've emailed you its reference.

errors.already_in_progress: Work has started on this request, so it can't be cancelled now.
errors.request_closed: This request is finished, so it can't be cancelled.
errors.export_deleted: The copy has been deleted. Make a new request if you need another.

denied.title: This request isn't yours to see
denied.body: You can see the privacy requests you made, and those about a child you look after.
